parallels.note: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

translations.web: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said, “Blessed are you who are poor, God’s Kingdom is yours.
translations.bsb: Looking up at His disciples, Jesus said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
translations.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
translations.asv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed are ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
